A hub keeps this home in sync when nobody has the app open at the same time. Set one up on a computer that is nearly always on.
A hub is a computer that stays on and keeps a copy of this home's shared data, so there is always something there to hand changes over.
It runs a plain x0x daemon.
It needs no app, no account and no settings of its own.
Without a hub, two people only get each other's changes when both have Vesta open at the same time. With one, nobody has to be online together.
Add milk at the shops and everyone sees it later.
Changes wait at the hub until someone collects them.
The hub is an ordinary member of this home's private group. Other devices leave their changes with it and pick up other people's from it.
Your device passes changes to the hub whenever it is online.
